sentences.translation: I'll get a little bit of a eye.
But I opened my eyes again.
Today is the day of Fuyu.
I want to go under my back tomorrow.
"I'm a wolf," said my mother, in a stove.
I can put some water in.
A mother takes her child's hand.
The two of you sit down.
A child is going to take a bite of coffee.
There is something small on top of a tree.
It is a small white fin.
"Do you want to go out today?" the child asked.
We are warm and very smart.
A small swab comes out of coffee.
The moon is no longer there.
I feel the white yuki with it.
Today is the day of Fuyu.
